conviction_note: Mostly a non-result with a small long lean: Agora has beaten the top of its own revenue guide in each of the last two quarters (Q1 $37.7m vs $36-37m, Q2 $40.4m vs $39-40m), the stock went into the print down 9.6% over 20 days with the CEO's 10b5-1 plan buying daily, and the market cap (~$332m) sits under the last reported cash pile ($361.7m); but a beat-and-raise was sold -3.9% in August, the bar is only the company's guide, and the stock trades on the Q4 guide, which nothing I found pins down, so p_up 56 on a 7% scale gives +0.84 against an impact_sum of +1.3 (the findings are small and individually sized; the gap is the uncertainty about the Q4 guide that only p_up carries).
bar: Company guidance for Q3 2026 total revenue $41.0-42.0m (midpoint $41.5m, +15.8% to +18.6% YoY), given 2026-08-13 in the Q2 release: https://pr.taosnews.com/article/Agora-Inc-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/6a7e3f39e2557832e110eaec . No sourced sell-side revenue consensus found (Benzinga/Digrin/TipRanks blank or paywalled; Chartmill shows FY2026 EPS consensus $0.09 from 3 analysts as of 2026-10-17, MarketBeat FY EPS $0.15 - the two disagree). Sized against the company guide. Q4 2025 revenue base for the Q4 guide is $38.2m (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1802883/000119312526086532/api-ex99_1.htm).
positioning_check: Short interest small: ~439k ADS short as of 2026-09-30, 2.7 days to cover (massive.com/quote/api); ~471k ADS as of 2026-10-02, 4.5 days, ~0.6% of float (equibles.com/stocks/api/shortinterest); 451k ADS, 2.23% of float as of 2026-10-15 (chartmill). Not a crowded short. Options: front chain unusable (no two-sided ATM quotes), no skew number; put/call OI ratio 0.01 on 1,543 contracts, i.e. essentially call-only open interest. Tape: spot $3.96, -7.7% over 5 days and -9.6% over 20 days, 24.9% off the 52-week high; CEO Tony Zhao's vehicle YY TZ Limited has bought ~9-10k ADS nearly every session since 2026-09-16 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-15 (Form 4s, latest filed 2026-11-16 covering 11-12 and 11-13 buys at $4.21 and $3.94).

findings.finding: Agora beat the TOP of its own revenue guide in each of the last two quarters - Q1 2026 $37.7m against a $36.0-37.0m guide (+$0.7m over the high end), Q2 2026 $40.4m against $39.0-40.0m (+$0.4m) - and the Q3 guide of $41.0-42.0m was set on 2026-08-13, so the same pattern points to roughly $42.2-42.7m, about 2-3% above the $41.5m midpoint, which is the only sourced bar; Q2's gross margin (63.7%) was also up sequentially from Q1 (63.4%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 (release 2026-05-26 evening, beat top of guide, Q2 guide implied acceleration): stock 3.77 -> 4.23 on 2026-05-27, +12.2% (Yahoo daily bars). Q2 2026 (release 2026-08-13 evening, beat top of guide, Q3 guide raised to $41-42m): 4.83 -> 4.64 on 2026-08-14, -3.9%, after +7.8% on the release day itself. Q3 2025: +9.06% (baseline). Q4 2025: -2.56% (baseline). So the same beat-the-guide line has been bought twice and sold twice; the difference was the run-in (Q1 fell into the print, Q2 rallied into it). This time the stock fell 9.6% into the print. NB the baseline mis-dates Q1: it carries 2026-05-28 (+0.47%) and 2026-06-01 (+15.85%); the true Q1 reaction day is 2026-05-27, and 06-01 was the CEO share-purchase-plan announcement, not a print.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide-beat cadence is visible to anyone who reads two releases, so part of it is in any model; but with no published revenue consensus beyond the guide and the stock down 9.6% over 20 days and 7.7% in the last 5 (no pre-print bid, unlike the +7.8% run into the Q2 print), the tape does not look like a market positioned for another top-of-range beat. If it were priced, the stock would have firmed into the print as it did in August.
findings.independence: Q2 beat-the-top-of-range is from a separate document: https://pr.taosnews.com/article/Agora-Inc-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/6a7e3f39e2557832e110eaec (2026-08-13). Both are the company's own releases - two quarters of one pattern, not an independent series.

findings.finding: Twilio, which reported 2026-10-29 (after Agora last spoke), said voice revenue grew more than 20% YoY, self-serve voice ~55%, with voice-AI deals named as a driver - a read-through to Agora's conversational-AI engine, which management said should reach ~5% of revenue on a Q4 exit run-rate; Twilio's stock nonetheless fell 15%+ on a soft Q4 guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance of Agora reacting to a peer's voice-AI print found. Agora's own AI line is <5% of revenue, so its print turns on core real-time engagement and the Q4 guide, not the AI share.
findings.why_not_priced: Agora's ADR has drifted down since Twilio's print rather than catching any voice-AI bid; a market reading Twilio's voice strength into Agora would show it in the tape. But the transmission is a proxy: Twilio's customers are not Agora's, and about half of Agora's revenue is China (Shengwang).
findings.independence: Proxy only. Twilio Q3 commentary on voice AI also at https://futurumgroup.com/?p=97371 (same print). Agora's own Q2 call said AI ramp is call-center/outbound-survey led: https://vectorshift.ai/research/companies/agora/earnings/2026-q2-summary

findings.finding: The CEO's personal vehicle YY TZ Limited has bought Agora ADS on almost every session since 2026-09-16 under a 10b5-1 plan adopted 2026-06-15 (about 9-10k ADS a day, ~8% of the 20-day average volume of 121k ADS; holdings 1,957,606 -> 2,347,872 ADS, ~390k ADS or ~$1.6m by 2026-11-13), part of a publicly announced up-to-$20m, 12-month purchase plan; the plan continues through the print.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The plan's announcement on 2026-06-01 moved the stock +15.85% that day and +10.7% the next (Yahoo bars; GlobeNewswire 2026-06-01). The buying itself has not stopped a 10% decline since late October.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the plan is public and the buying is pre-scheduled. What may not be fully reflected is that at ~$1.6m in two months the plan is far behind the $20m/12-month pace, leaving room for a larger pace or a privately negotiated block; nothing in the tape shows that expectation.
findings.independence: Earlier Form 4 (buys 2026-09-16 to 10-09): https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1802883/000119312526419691/ownership.xml ; plan announcement https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/06/01/3304332/0/en/Agora-Inc-Announces-Management-Share-Purchase-Plan.html . Same filer, same plan.

findings.finding: At $3.96 x 83.8m ADS the market cap is about $332m against $361.7m of cash, deposits and financial products at 2026-06-30, and the $200m company buyback has ~$40m left and expires end-February 2027 (Q2 repurchases $3.7m, Q1 $13.1m) - a renewal or enlargement could be announced with Q3, though nothing the company has said dates it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Capital-return news moved this stock: the 2026-06-01 CEO purchase-plan release +15.85%. Management said on the Q2 call it may consider a special dividend in future but not currently, and is not considering going private.
findings.why_not_priced: The below-cash valuation is public and has persisted for years, so on its own it is priced; the only unpriced part is the timing of a new authorisation, which is an inference from the expiry date, not a stated plan.
findings.independence: Q2 call summary (special dividend not current, no go-private): https://vectorshift.ai/research/companies/agora/earnings/2026-q2-summary . Shares the cash/buyback figures with the Q2 release.

findings.finding: Management's stated goal is quarterly GAAP operating profitability by year-end 2026 (Q2 operating loss $1.0m, narrowed from $3.1m); at the Q3 guide midpoint and Q2's 63.7% gross margin, ~$1m more gross profit puts Q3 operating income near break-even, so a first GAAP operating profit could print a quarter early - but conversational-AI costs are named as the gross-margin drag and R&D rose 10% YoY in Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The return to GAAP net profit in Q3 2025 was greeted with +9.06% (RTTNews headline 'Agora shares rise 11% on higher revenue and return to profit in Q3'); later net-profit quarters drew -2.56% and -3.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely inside what the company told the market to expect (operating profit by year-end), so near zero; it only adds if it arrives in Q3 rather than Q4.
findings.independence: Q2 release figures (operating loss, gross margin, R&D): https://pr.taosnews.com/article/Agora-Inc-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results/6a7e3f39e2557832e110eaec . Same company documents as finding 1 for the revenue input.

outside_window.finding: The company's $200m repurchase program expires end-February 2027; a renewal decision is due by then whether or not it comes with this print.

searched_and_found_nothing: Sell-side Q3 revenue consensus: Benzinga, Digrin, TipRanks, MarketBeat, Chartmill - none publishes a Q3 2026 revenue number; only FY EPS consensus, and two sources disagree ($0.09 vs $0.15)

Shengwang / China usage data: iRTE2026 conference coverage (qbitai.com/2026/10/504913.html, sfccn.com 2026-10-23) carries no usage, customer or revenue figures, only the CEO's five-level framework and a Rokid partnership mention
Agora 6-K / press releases since the Q2 release: EDGAR submissions show no 6-K after 2026-08-14, only Form 4s (CEO 10b5-1 buys, director RSU vests)
English-language Agora news for Oct-Nov 2026 on conversational AI: nothing dated in the window beyond the iRTE event

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with (unusable chain, call-only OI); the small long lean cuts against a 20-day run-up of -9.6% only in the sense that the market has been selling into the print, which I read as low expectations rather than information, and that reading moved p_up only to 56.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (verified fact is not a reaction): the guide-beat finding cut 0.8 -> 0.6 because the same beat-the-top line drew -3.9% in August as well as +12.2% in May; p_up 57 -> 56.
Rule 5 (proxy smaller; unexplained drawdown worth 0): Twilio read-through 0.3 -> 0.2; the below-cash / buyback-renewal finding 0.4 -> 0.2 since cheapness alone is priced and the renewal is inference.
Rule 6 (inside the guided path): the GAAP operating-profit finding 0.2 -> 0.1, as the company already guided to operating profit by year-end; buyback expiry filed in outside_window.
Positioning (rule 7): CEO 10b5-1 buying is public and pre-scheduled, 0.3 -> 0.2; short interest checked and small, so no squeeze adjustment needed.
FPI history lesson: rebuilt the base rate from confirmed releases (Q1 reaction is 05-27 +12.2%, 06-01 was not a print); abs_move_pct left at 7.
Rule 6 bar check: bar is a company guide, so findings were not capped further.
